description: Shareable Renovate preset: born-mergeable PRs (release-age gated), daily grouped non-major automerge, minimal CI churn.

packageRules.description: Prod deps (non-major): grouped daily, automerge on green
Dev/tooling deps (non-major): grouped daily, automerge on green. The packageManager pin counts as tooling: with no rule of its own, its green PRs waited for a human.

CI/tooling managers (GitHub Actions, Dockerfiles, custom managers such as the biome schema tracker, etc.) ride with dev deps — they were arriving as individual PRs that went stale behind their siblings

Majors automerge too, but stay individual (never grouped) so one breaking bump can't block unrelated updates, and soak longer than the fleet default: a major's early patch releases are where the regressions surface, and CI can only catch what it tests.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the schedule and merge on green. The 1-day soak MIRRORS pnpm 11's own minimumReleaseAge (1440 min) — Renovate's default here is null, which would open a PR that pnpm then refuses to install, so it sits red for a day and trains everyone to ignore red. Same landing time either way; this way the PR is born installable. Keep this value in step with pnpm's.
